text: あなた　わたしより　つよいわ！

patterns.name: 〜より
patterns.span: わたしより　つよい
patterns.explanation: より after a word means 'than' that word when comparing. わたしより　つよい = 'stronger than me'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of stating something. つよいわ = 'you're strong!'
